title: Use Cases | ContextMint
description: ContextMint use cases — decision-control for engineering leaders, platform teams, and security.

hero.title: Who needs evidence before AI ships?
hero.lead: Different roles, same question: can we trust assisted changes with visible evidence? ContextMint answers in the IDE today — Verification Engine PR gates remain on the roadmap.

cards.title: CTO & VP Engineering
cards.text: Govern AI-assisted work with human gates, quality-map findings, and a clear v1.0 vs roadmap story.

cards.title: Platform Engineering
cards.text: Local Engine or shared on-prem path, context packs, and IDE gates. PR gates and MCP on the roadmap.

cards.title: Security & Compliance
cards.text: Local-first default, optional OIDC shared-server path, human apply gates, and honest certification roadmap.
